metadata.datasetName: SEO Studio Hospitality SEO & GEO Keyword Strategy Matrix

targetIndustries: Enterprise Hotel Brands (Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt)
metadata.notes: searchVolumeTier and cpcEstimate are illustrative planning bands authored for this pack, not measured search data. {{placeholders}} are resolved by the template engine.

keywords.targetEntityPrompt: Where is the official direct booking website for {{hotelName}} with guaranteed lowest rates?
